JABVOX_PROVISIONING_CHAT.TITLE: Provisioning Chat
JABVOX_PROVISIONING_CHAT.SUBTITLE: Ask Manty to create the MCPs for your account
JABVOX_PROVISIONING_CHAT.EMPTY: No messages yet. Type something to get started.

STATUS.LABEL: Provisioning status
STATUS.PENDING_HINT: Your account has no MCPs yet. Press the button to create Manty and its MCPs.
STATUS.PROVISIONING_HINT: We are creating Manty and its MCPs. This may take a moment.
STATUS.READY_HINT: Manty and your MCPs are ready to use.
STATUS.FAILED_HINT: An error occurred during provisioning. You can retry.

ERROR.LOAD_STATUS: Could not load the provisioning status.
ERROR.LOAD_MESSAGES: Could not load the message history.
ERROR.APPROVAL: Could not respond to the authorization request.

APPROVAL.TITLE: The agent is asking for permission to run this
APPROVAL.TIMEOUT_HINT: If you do not respond within 5 minutes it counts as denied and the command will not run.

STEER.NO_RUN: There is no active run to steer.
STEER.EMPTY: Type the guidance after /steer. Example: /steer focus on account 2

MODEL_CMD.NO_SESSION: No Manty session yet. Send a message first.
